items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And we played for the dancer, a one-legged dancer, Fox.

ctx.x: happen today; it just runs off. It was all smeared up. And even if I could read, I'd have had trouble, you know!

I think that the opening number was "What Are The Melons(?) Like In Dixie." [LAUGHS, SINGS] A (?) thing. So the cat says... We had time to rehearse. The curtain is down. "Okay, hit it!" And the curtain went up, and all five of us started crying because none of us could read. So he yells, "What the hell is the matter!?" I'm the one that spoke out and said, "We can't read no music." "Oh my God!", you know. So they figured out a tune that we could play, so they could use it for the opening, and they did that, you…
